text:
Large caps slipped on Monday while smallcaps gained.

• Sensex closed at 71,924.68, down 547.65 points (0.76%); Nifty 50 closed at 22,363.35, down 157.10 points (0.70%), per Business Standard and Kotak Neo closing reports.
• Nifty Smallcap 100 rose 1.42% and Nifty Midcap 100 rose 0.08%.
• Reports cited continued FII selling and rising bond yields; crude eased after a remark on pausing attacks on energy installations (Brent Dec futures $105.68, per Kotak Neo).
• Sectors were mixed: Nifty Media +4.60%, Nifty Auto +0.90%, Nifty PSU Bank -1.18%.

Our view: a day when the benchmark index falls while smallcaps rise is a reminder that index levels and the average portfolio can tell different stories. One day is a thin sample, so we read this as dispersion, not a trend. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: when benchmarks and broader indices diverge, how do you present it to clients without over-reading a single session?
